boundaries.memory: reported native VM/RSS records are measurements; 129MiB/32MiB are configured logical/capacity conditions, not an RSS hard bound
boundaries.pool: no pool on historical default D/F path; no network capacity budget applies
boundaries.save: save_verified starts through returned owning output string; first/repeated output destruction excluded; source prep, pretouch, full values/readback, optional wire write, memory sampling, process startup/final destruction excluded
boundaries.vector: sum of 4096-element append batches; fixed preallocated logical extent; setup, full values, save/load/readback and wire output excluded
boundaries.wire_retention: --wire-path writes the full final validated wire outside native timers for every process; retained SHA-256 and full bytes; this IO can affect later process state and is held fixed

calibration.canonical_wire_binding: all native wire V1 headers and exact deterministic extent/semantic IDs checked; functional independently recomputes FNV once per distinct full-wire SHA256 (cached; historical two distinct files approx68MiB); same-case D/F full bytes must match. Calibration outputs pin approved functional SHA256/FNV/header tuple and never repeat Python FNV across78 outputs.
checks: AB and BA median log-ratio bias
absolute per-case/per-metric cross-anchor drift: pooled median max/min <=1.01 and side A/B median max/min <=1.01; preserve per-anchor A/B full absolute sample distributions
calibration.interpretation: single bounded calibration only; no equivalence/bootstrap/population or D/F adoption claim; separate comparison preregistration and at least three independent qualified confirmation windows required
calibration.measured: pre/mid/post anchors; 4 F/F pairs per case/anchor; pair orders AB,BA,AB,BA; 72 processes; rotate case order by anchor
calibration.state: disabled until external parent approval JSON and externally supplied approval SHA256 bind exact contract/bridge/preregister/build/functional hashes and one exclusive calibration output
calibration.warmup: one F/F pair per case = 6 processes, excluded from statistics

environment: before/after snapshots outside native timers under same queue window: UTC+Asia/Shanghai, OS uname/platform, CPU logical count, Darwin sysctl brand/physical/logical/memory, load average, disk bytes, ps pid/comm/%cpu/%mem, pmset power source+thermal; each command bounded5s and UTF8 replacement, unavailable/error reasons retained. Presence does not establish quiet host.

native_schema.format: one complete JSON document; exact frozen serializer fields; no extra stdout; UTF-8
native_schema.unavailable: owner_probe_count=null; never interpret as zero owner work
native_schema.units: all *_ms milliseconds; *_bytes bytes; *_est estimates, never precise events; checksum fields unsigned 64-bit FNV values

queue.build: exact inherited compile flags; relocate only source include, translation unit and output; D/F sequential, max two compiles
queue.execution: run_job wraps the entire build, functional job, or calibration window once; no nested queue; direct Python bridge child, inherited session
queue.functional: six native processes: each exact case D then F; full semantic/work/layout identity, V1 header and same-case D/F full wire SHA equality; cached FNV independently binds raw checksum to full retained bytes; timing fields carry no performance claim
queue.provenance: start_run freezes full queue request SHA256, exact command, actual bridge path/SHA256, interpreter executable path/resolved path/bytes/SHA256 and Python version in payload execution-context.json. Offline audit requires request SHA match, exact original command and interpreter context; functional result hash transitively pins queue request before parent approval.

scope: exact historical D/F source bridge; one calibration-only attempt before any D/F comparison

source_and_toolchain.current_identity: compiler driver preserved; resolved compiler and libc++/ABI/unwind hashes; complete -isystem and compiler implicit include byte manifests; SDKSettings hash; machine/page size; before/after identity checks
limitations: SDKSettings is not a complete SDK/OS byte manifest
system-library/OS behavior is not captured by bundled runtime hashes
source_and_toolchain.offline: bundle embeds frozen protocol/source/runtime/build/functional evidence and all raw native stdout/stderr, process receipts, normalized mapping and full wire. Audit reopens no original absolute artifact paths and writes nothing; exact original argv is reconstructed from accepted queue request out root. Completed calibration requires external accepted approval SHA256.
source_and_toolchain.source: prepare_default.py audit must pass all eight historical D/F source files; production headers remain read-only; deterministic layout/semantic assertions tie this bridge to inherited arm64 harness, not a cross-platform benchmark
